column1: # exp2 space utilization (utilization = payload_bytes / allocated_bytes). N=4096 full window
# methods: fifo_bounded / chained_hash_bounded / balanced_tree_bounded / psn_dynblock(elastic) / ring_fixed(S=4096)

# overhead_per_pkt (B) = (allocated_bytes - payload_bytes) / N：每驻留包分摊的空间开销
# lower_bound_util = pl / (align16(pl) + sizeof(slot_meta_t))：位置槽理想利用率上界（仅对齐填充+12B meta，无索引/桶/FIFO 指针），方法无关
